intro x y,
assume h: x < y,
have h1: x ≥ 0 := Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 (Set.Ici.mem_iff.2 (Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 h)),
have h2: y ≥ 0 := Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 (Set.Ici.mem_iff.2 (Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 h)),
have h3: x ≠ y := ne_of_lt h,
have h4: x < y := h,
have h5: Int.natAbs x < Int.natAbs y :=
  Int.natAbs_strictMono_on_Ici.1 h4,
exact h5
